Tracked and cleaned temporary NpmCommandRunnerTests directories, including junction-safe teardown.

Reloaded a surviving extension into the host when uninstall cancellation arrives after stop but before delete completes.
Parsed prerelease/build SemVer suffixes correctly when mapping JavaScript extension package versions.
